# CRM integration with Doxis

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/2/customer-happiness-szr1wh7bnnc8xwj.svg)

### Happier customers

Better informed customer service colleagues can respond to inquiries faster and with greater precision to strengthen customer retention.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/b/approval%202-zaac3psev1qpr4w.svg)

### Always ready to provide information

Create a single source of truth for all customer information — for employees with and without Salesforce access

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/g/agile-process-automation-xtfwa9bpcpb6bds.svg)

### Greater back office productivity

Automate back office processes, e.g. document archiving, process monitoring and customer file creation.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/0/DEVK-logo-fbs2vbv3jxptwdp.png)

### Information basis for informed responses

Lay the foundation for a 360° view of all customer processes and information and access them directly from your CRM system or Doxis.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/j/compliance-and-governance-c20xq4h6pm6d1vz.svg)

### Mitigate legal risks

Automate the archiving of important documents from your CRM system and prove compliance with data retention periods and data protection requirements such as the [EU GDPR](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/gdpr-compliance).

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/r/authorities%20legal-38c4t4m6w1awqm9.svg)

### Familiar work environment

Continue working as normal in your CRM system and and access related quotations, contracts and emails straight from the application or switch to the [customer file](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/digital-customer-file) using the link provided, for a complete overview.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/k/expedited-efficiency-49ke9q9wt0gs505.svg)

### Faster processes, better service

Doxis automatically launches and monitors downstream [processes](https://www.doxis.com/en/automate-workflows) — from delivery date inquiries directed to Shipping, to questions for the Sales team, nothing falls through the cracks.

### Connectors for your CRM system

Your customers are important to you. That’s why you work with CRM systems from [Salesforce](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/salesforce), [SAP,](https://www.doxis.com/en/sap/dms-for-sap) [Microsoft](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/microsoft-365), Oracle and others, to ensure professional support. Each and every inquiry needs to be answered fast, reliably and with the necessary expertise. But your CRM system only contains a portion of the information you need. This is evident every time you need to answer inquiries about contracts or arrangements made via email, etc. With the integration of CRM & Doxis, you have direct access to information from all sources — the answers are always at your fingertips.

## Case study

> With Doxis, we now have a stable platform that runs around the clock. Our customer files are always found quickly and easily — regardless of where they are located.
>
> Martin Mermolja, Sunrise Communications AG

[Read now](https://www.doxis.com/en/medialibrary/sunrise-communications-company-wide-information-management)

[![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/s/AnwB_Sunrise_EN-bcxt01qn8waff6n.png)](https://www.doxis.com/en/medialibrary/sunrise-communications-company-wide-information-management)

### Utilize the benefits of ECM with your CRM system

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/j/process-automation-optimization-hze1eyhzep6hbeb.svg)

### Automatic processes

When new eFiles are created, Doxis automatically starts the relevant [workflows](https://www.doxis.com/en/automate-workflows) in the CRM system, such as customer onboarding. You’ll find all the information about the process in Doxis as conveniently as in your CRM tool.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/w/business-apps-connectors-ks7caa6sdr1aqed.svg)

### Collaboration

The Doxis [iRoom](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/collaboration) enhances your CRM system: It’s a secure space to provide customers with quotations, contracts, product information and much more directly and fully traceable at all times.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/1/profitability-value-benefits-nx6bkmwb99cs1s7.svg)

### Content analytics

With Doxis [Cognitive Services](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/content-understanding), take advantage of content analytics also for automatic data mining from your CRM system. This is how you save time and prevent errors.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/j/compliance-and-governance-c20xq4h6pm6d1vz.svg)

### Compliance

Doxis automatically and [compliantly](https://www.doxis.com/en/compliance/audit-security) archives all document versions from your CRM system. The result: transparent documentation of all customer processes, such as for complaints or the [EU GDPR](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/gdpr-compliance).

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/b/incoming-together-vawd2w7ysdbv3vf.svg)

### Metadata inheritance

Doxis imports new documents from integrated systems — with all metadata. They are filed correctly and automatically, and can therefore be discovered quickly.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/7/case-management-xn194z0sjny9dke.svg)

### Allocation to eFiles

Doxis automatically creates [eFiles](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/electronic-files) for new documents, business partners and more, assigns documents and data to the corresponding files and displays selected views of customers, suppliers and processes.

## Integration of your IT landscape with Doxis

[Integrate](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/business-connectors) Doxis into your IT systems. Doxis offers a large number of standard connectors for applications including CRM systems like Salesforce, SAP, Oracle etc., as well as various [ERP systems](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/erp-integration), Microsoft Exchange/Outlook, Office, SharePoint, HR solutions such as SAP, ADP Paisy, Varial etc., and CAD systems and directory services like LDAP.
